requirements_summary: Workloads: real-time chat (customer support) + semantic doc search (embeddings).
Latency targets: median chat RTF <300ms token latency; end-to-end single-turn <500ms typical (prefer <300ms).
Throughput: bursts up to ~60 concurrent chat sessions; expect 50k tokens/day during pilot.
Cost sensitivity: high — prefer lower-cost models or quantized variants; willing to trade slight quality drop for 3x cost reduction.
Model preferences/questions: evaluating Llama-2 / Mistral-instruct / Qwen family (13B and 7B variants); wants guidance on quality vs cost and fallback strategy.
Quantization interest: asks about 4-bit vs 8-bit production stability, hallucination impact, and latency improvements on hosted GPU infra.
Routing/fallback: wants simple policy — use cheaper model for most queries, fallback to higher-quality model for low-confidence answers.
Security: SSO/SAML, basic audit logs retention 90 days, encryption-at-rest (KMS) — legal will confirm once SOC2 doc seen.
Eval metrics: preference to evaluate on in-house prompt set (50 examples) focusing on correctness, helpfulness, and token cost per query.
